//: Standalone type-check config for frontend/specs/*.ts. This directory is NOT part of tsconfig.app.json's include (only "src" is), so `npx tsc --noEmit` run from frontend/ silently skips these files — verified by injecting a deliberate type error into api-types.ts and confirming the bare command still exits 0. Run `npx tsc -p specs --noEmit` from frontend/ (or `npx tsc -p frontend/specs --noEmit` from repo root) to actually check these files. Deliberately NOT merged into tsconfig.app.json: that decision (move these types into src/lib/ vs. wire specs/ into the app build) is still open — see the note at the end of components.md.
